retentionSemantics.genericTerminalHistory: Each retained terminal row names its supplied source focus. The qualified terminal is generic; its historical unqualified sourceFacet is not its event-profile meaning. Preserve separate (question, focus) histories without changing prior answers.
retentionSemantics.focusDisposition: Every retained focus is explicitly open or assessed. Assessed requires a retained applicable nonterminal question; a generic event match or terminal alone does not assess a fixed evidence facet.
retentionSemantics.hypothesisContext: A supplied hypothesis and its actual answer remain separate. Independent fact-led scope, relation, source and effect may omit a hypothesis; omission is preserved without inventing an identifier.
